sneaker_of_the_day.prompt: A high-resolution, 1080p, exact replica of the '{sneaker_name}' sneaker as the central product. The sneaker is clean, crisp, and displayed in a futuristic, minimal, and elegant spaceship product showcase. No people in the image. The showcase features soft cyan and deep indigo ambient lighting, with subtle holographic UI elements around the shoe. Sleek metallic and carbon fiber surfaces within the spaceship. The aesthetic is extremely premium, professional, and state-of-the-art. Minimalist background to keep the focus on the product.
